summary.value: Dud Bolt holds no shame in doing whatever it takes to win...or earn a paycheck. The Vulptereen is a fan favorite on the track, as well as an ally of Sebulba's, who has on many occasions paid the racer to take down fellow competitors mid-race.

description.value: Built on his homeworld of Vulpter, the Vulptereen 327 podracer is perfect for the aggressive Dud Bolt, boasting excellent traction to power down straights. A vehicle built tough, Dud Bolt's favorite pastime is ramming into his opponents as he flies by unscathed, laughing as he does.
While on straights, Afterburner power and top speed are increased.
While Cornering, top speed is reduced.
